zoe-pm: Idea: banded fallback orchestration. Instead of a single fallback path, classify traffic into sensitivity bands (critical | standard | best_effort) and apply graded actions per band. Goals: predictable UX for critical users, better cost control, and faster automated recovery.

mike-platform: I like that. We should document actions per band. Proposal: critical -> only token smoothing / reserved pool; standard -> model downgrade then reroute; best_effort -> immediate aggressive fallback (stub responses) + logging.

ana-research: Measurement plan: run an A/B where 10% of standard traffic uses banded policy vs control. Track p95, user_accept_rate, and quality_delta. Use blind eval on sampled prompts to estimate semantic loss.

zoe-pm: Flag surface (draft):
```
banded_fallback_mode: off | monitor | banded
banded_buckets: {critical: pct, standard: pct, best_effort: pct}
banded_actions: {critical: [throttle, reserved], standard: [throttle, downgrade, reroute], best_effort: [downgrade, reroute, stub]}
band_exempt_tenants: [ids]
band_canary_pct: 0-100
band_cooldown_s: 600
max_band_evictions_per_min: 20
```
Keep bucket assignment rules explicit: by tenant_tag, route, or request header.

hannah-sales: Customers will want to map contracts to bands. We'll need an API to tag a tenant as `band=critical` and a billing appendix for reserved capacity.

mike-platform: Safety rules: only trigger cross-region reroute for bands where reroute is allowed and after a cooling window. Telemetry: per-band p95, error-rate, and band-switch events. Rollback triggers: per-band error_rate > 1.5% for 3m OR p95 increase > 120ms for 2m.

ana-research: Canary plan: step 0 shadow band assignment -> step 1 small A/B (control vs banded) at 5% standard traffic for 30m -> increase to 20% for 1h if stable. Evaluate quality delta and retention signals. Capture prompt snapshots for failed flows.

zoe-pm: Launch criteria:
- Band A/B shows < 0.5% increase in error-rate for critical band
- standard band p95 delta < 40ms and quality delta within threshold
- Exemption API tested end-to-end
- Runbook + panic button available for each band

mike-platform: Ops checklist: implement band assignment module, add token bucket rate limiter per band, expose per-band dashboards, and add simulation tests with traffic replay. Also add a feature-flag gate for turning banded mode on region-by-region.

hannah-sales: I'll prepare customer-facing FAQ mapping contract tiers -> bands and options for reserved capacity windows.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: `rollout/banded-fallback/v1` -> canary start 2026-04-05T10:00:00Z (5% standard traffic, A/B)

zoe-pm: Thanks. If anyone has concerns about band definitions or must-have protections for specific customers, drop them here and I'll fold into the PRD.
